name: mdn/open-language-menu
description: Open MDN Web Docs and click its page language button so the list of languages is showing.
source_task: Open https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/ and click the page language button ("English (US)") so the language list is showing. This is an unattended test. Do not wait for a person. Decide yourself. Never buy, send, submit, save or delete anything. Leave the application window open when you are done.

steps.note: The language switcher in the page header; the list it opens names other languages such as Français.

else.goal: Open the page's language menu by clicking the button labelled '{button}' so the list of available languages is showing. Do not choose a language and do not leave the page. Stop as soon as the language list is open.
